toolCall.argumentsJson: {"CommandLine":"powershell -Command \"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*_daemon*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*Ingestor*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*Worker*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -Verbose }\"","Cwd":"c:\\AI-BS","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Terminating all background loop daemons","toolSummary":"Stop all background daemon processes"}
